injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.detail: White (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Josh Giddey
injuries.detail: Giddey (wrist) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.name: Zach Collins
injuries.detail: Collins (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Jordan Hawkins
injuries.detail: Hawkins (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (knee) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Dailyn Swain
injuries.detail: Swain (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Caleb Martin
injuries.detail: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Jett Howard
injuries.detail: Howard (calf) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince (personal) is listed as probable for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Brandin Podziemski
injuries.detail: Podziemski (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.detail: Bassey (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Adams (calf) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.detail: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.detail: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jake LaRavia
injuries.detail: LaRavia (ankle) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.detail: Thiero (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Cameron Carr
injuries.detail: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Cedric Coward
injuries.detail: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Branden Carlson
injuries.detail: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.detail: Fox (wrist) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Keldon Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Rockets due to a mouth laceration.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.detail: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Malik Monk
injuries.detail: Monk (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Tony Bradley
injuries.detail: Bradley (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Felix Okpara
injuries.detail: Okpara (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.detail: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
